newsitem.title: CYPRUS: OPEC July output up at 26.44 mln bpd - MEES.
newsitem.headline: OPEC July output up at 26.44 mln bpd - MEES.

text.p: OPEC July output rose by a modest 60,000 barrels per day (bpd) to reach 26.44 million bpd compared to 26.38 million bpd in June, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) newsletter reported on Monday.

"Lower production in Nigeria (down 55,000 bpd), mainly as a result of temporary problems in the Shell production and export system, was more than counterbalanced by increased output in Venezuela (up 50,000 bpd...), Kuwait (up 40,000 bpd), Iran (up 15,000) and Saudi Arabia (up 10,000 bpd).
"Meanwhile, a substantial increment is expected to be added to OPEC output in August following the restart of Iraqi exports in the middle of the month," the Cyprus-based newsletter said.
MEES said that according to data from its sources, Iran's crude exports averaged 2.436 million bpd in July, a modest increase of 18,000 bpd over 2.418 million bpd in June.

"Allowing for estimated deliveries to domestic refineries of 1.2 million bpd in July, Iran's crude oil production for the month is put at 3.636 million bpd as compared with 3.618 million bpd in June," it added.
A Reuter survey also put the 11-member OPEC output at 26.44 million bpd in July.
